entries.title: feat: add project installer
entries.proposed_patch: Added docs/product/raw/project-installer.md documenting the installer entrypoints, sync scope, repo-local companion preservation, .github preservation behavior, dry-run behavior, and optional bootstrap-issue-config follow-up.
entries.reason: PR #148 adds a user-facing project installer and changes the long-term onboarding/sync workflow for adopting AICodingFlow in target repositories. The behavior includes durable install entrypoints, copied paths, preservation rules, dry-run semantics, and optional bootstrap guidance that were not covered by existing product docs.

entries.title: fix(pr-comments): handle multi-comment fix requests
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the PR comment response workflow source doc to describe review_comment_ids.json resolved/outdated thread state, multi-inline-comment request handling, unresolved-state rules, outdated-comment handling, and one resolved_review_comments entry per resolved inline comment.
entries.reason: PR #150 changes the long-term behavior contract for the PR comment response workflow: body-level /fix requests can target all, unresolved, or category-scoped inline review comments, and unresolved/outdated state now has explicit interpretation rules. Existing product docs described the workflow and resolved comment output, but did not document these multi-comment scope and thread-state semantics.

entries.title: fix(review): allow CI bot dispatch
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative AI PR Review raw doc to state that workflow_dispatch review runs allow `github-actions[bot]`, enabling target-project CI workflows to dispatch AI PR Review after CI without modifying the installed review-pr.yml.
entries.reason: PR #155 changes the AI PR Review integration contract by allowing `github-actions[bot]` to run the Codex review action when CI dispatches the workflow. Existing product docs described workflow_dispatch as a trigger but did not record the CI bot dispatch behavior or its no-local-workflow-customization purpose.

entries.title: ci(review): dispatch AI review after CI
entries.proposed_patch: Updated raw product docs to describe CI-driven AI PR Review dispatch, github-actions[bot] dispatch behavior, queued/failed AI PR Review commit status handling, and the installer exclusion for the reference .github/workflows/ci.yml.
entries.reason: PR #154 changed the AI PR Review trigger model from direct pull_request handling to CI-driven workflow_dispatch, and changed installer semantics so the reference ci.yml is not synced to target repositories. Existing product docs partially covered CI dispatch but still described direct pull_request review triggering, so authoritative docs needed correction.

entries.title: fix(install): isolate synced workflow tests
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the project installer product doc to name `.github/aicodingflow-tests/` as the managed synced test directory, clarify that target-project tests should remain outside that directory, and add PR #158 / Issue #157 as sources.
entries.reason: PR #158 changed the installer sync contract by moving AICodingFlow-managed workflow tests from `.github/tests/` to `.github/aicodingflow-tests/` and reserving `.github/tests/` for target-project-owned GitHub tests. Existing long-term product docs still described `.github/tests/` as an installed managed directory, so they needed correction.

entries.title: 增加 AGENTS.md、docs 目录
entries.proposed_patch: Added a narrow authoritative raw product doc describing the shared .agents directory, tool entrypoint symlinks, Claude/Cursor compatibility files, and Windows symlink guidance.
entries.reason: PR #159 introduces the shared agent directory layout and tool-specific symlink entrypoints for Claude, Codex, and Cursor, including Windows symlink setup expectations. This is durable product usage behavior that was not covered by existing product raw docs.

entries.title: test(install): split delivered test suite
entries.proposed_patch: 无需修改 docs/product/；现有项目安装脚本文档已经覆盖该行为。
entries.reason: PR #160 主要拆分 AICodingFlow 仓库自用测试与随安装交付的测试，并调整 CI 测试入口；长期安装边界已经由现有 docs/product/raw/project-installer.md 准确覆盖。现有文档已说明 .github/tests/ 与 .github/workflows/ci.yml 不会同步到目标项目，.github/aicodingflow-tests/ 是交付测试目录。

entries.title: docs(readme): simplify project documentation
entries.proposed_patch: Updated raw product docs to describe real top-level .claude/.codex/.cursor directories with inner symlinks to shared .agents content, and to document the pending/failure AI PR Review status behavior when CI has not passed.
entries.reason: PR #161 changed durable product behavior for tool entry directories and the AI PR Review status lifecycle. Existing raw product docs described the previous top-level symlink layout and did not state that the reference CI marks AI PR Review as failed when CI blocks review.

entries.title: fix(review): dismiss stale bot request changes
entries.proposed_patch: Updated docs/product/raw/pr-review-verdict.md to document stale bot REQUEST_CHANGES dismissal on later APPROVE, the configured bot-author boundary, the REVIEW_BOT_LOGIN default, and source references.
entries.reason: PR #162 changed long-term AI PR Review behavior: later APPROVE verdicts for non-member code PRs now attempt to dismiss stale bot-authored REQUEST_CHANGES reviews. It also introduced REVIEW_BOT_LOGIN as durable configuration for custom review bot identities, so the existing PR review verdict docs needed an authoritative update.

entries.title: ci(review): dispatch review after tests pass
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative PR review product doc to state that the reference CI workflow dispatches review only after successful tests and does not write AI PR Review commit statuses when tests fail, are skipped, or dispatch does not occur.
entries.reason: PR #163 changed the reference CI workflow's public AI PR Review status behavior: CI no longer pre-writes pending or failure statuses and only dispatches review after tests pass. Existing product docs still described the removed CI status writes, so long-term product docs needed correction.

entries.title: feat(skills): add create-issue skill
entries.proposed_patch: 新增 docs/product/raw/create-issue-skill.md，记录 create-issue 的适用入口、模板选择、issue 内容生成、metadata 边界、GitHub CLI 创建行为和安全报告私密披露规则。
entries.reason: PR #164 新增 create-issue skill，改变了本地开发流的 issue 创建入口、模板选择、metadata 处理和安全报告公开边界。现有 docs/product/raw/ 中没有该能力的权威长期产品说明，因此需要新增产品文档。

entries.title: docs(skill): add product change report workflow
entries.proposed_patch: 更新 docs/product/raw/product-change-reports.md，补充 product-change-report workflow 的 UTC 日期扫描、docs/updates 报告路径、ledger 去重、Codex 与外层 workflow 的职责边界，并把 PR #165 加入来源。
entries.reason: PR #165 新增 product-change-report skill 和 GitHub Actions workflow，改变了产品变更报告的生成流程、去重记录和自动化职责边界。现有产品文档只覆盖报告定义和后续校验规则，缺少这次合并后的长期 workflow 语义。

entries.title: Add product docs sync workflow
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch is needed because the existing product-change-report documentation already covers the durable workflow behavior; the HTTP method used by the helper script is an implementation detail.
entries.reason: The merged diff only changes the product-change-report context helper to call the GitHub search API with an explicit GET method and updates matching tests. This is CI/workflow plumbing and does not change long-term product concepts, user workflows, lifecycle rules, or public product behavior.

entries.title: fix(ci): prevent empty product report PRs
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative raw product change reports doc to cover UTC historical ranges, range report paths, reported versus scanned_no_update ledger statuses, empty/no-change report handling, and PR #168 as a source.
entries.reason: PR #168 changes long-term product behavior for product change reports: manual historical backfill inputs, range-based report naming, and ledger handling for empty or no-change outputs. Existing product docs described only single-day reports and did not document scanned_no_update semantics.

entries.title: fix(updates): auto-select report language
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative product change report source doc with durable report language selection rules and added PR #171 to the source references.
entries.reason: PR #171 changes the long-term behavior of the product change report workflow by adding automatic natural-language selection for generated or updated reports. Existing product docs covered report generation and write boundaries, but did not document how report language is chosen.

entries.title: docs: 集中管理 agent 语言偏好
entries.proposed_patch: 新增 raw 产品文档，说明集中管理的 agent 输出语言策略、上下文跟随规则、技术 token 保持原样的边界，以及 .agents/AGENTS.md 作为仓库级权威 guidance 的角色。
entries.reason: PR #172 引入了仓库级 agent 人类可读输出语言规则，并从具体 skills 和 workflows 中移除了重复的语言选择规则。现有产品文档只说明了共享 agent 目录布局，尚未记录这一长期 agent 行为约定。

entries.title: fix(ci): ignore closed PRs when updating workflow PRs
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the product change report and update-dedupe raw docs to state that workflow PR publishing only reuses open PRs on the same head branch, and added an authoritative raw update-pr-review workflow page with the same PR behavior plus its durable learning and write-boundary semantics.
entries.reason: PR #173 changed the long-term PR reuse semantics for workflow-created update PRs: product change reports, update-dedupe guidance, and update-pr-review guidance now only reuse open PRs on the same head branch. Existing product docs either lacked that open-PR rule for the affected workflows or lacked an authoritative raw doc for update-pr-review.

entries.title: chore: 移动 agent 指令到仓库根目录
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative raw product docs to describe root AGENTS.md as the shared guidance entrypoint, root CLAUDE.md as the Claude Code symlink to AGENTS.md, the remaining shared skills symlinks, and the PR #175 source reference.
entries.reason: PR #175 changed the long-term agent entrypoint layout by moving repository guidance to root AGENTS.md, adding root CLAUDE.md as the Claude Code symlink, and removing the old .claude/.codex guidance symlinks. Existing product docs still described .agents/AGENTS.md and the removed symlinks as authoritative, so they needed correction.

entries.title: Add product change report for 2026-05-26
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch is needed.
entries.reason: PR #174 only adds a dated product change report and its docs/updates ledger entry. This is a time-series update artifact, and the existing product docs already define product change reports as non-authoritative docs/updates output rather than long-term product truth.

entries.title: docs: 精简仓库代理说明
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative agent language policy doc to include commit-message summaries, workflow metadata examples such as pr_title, pr_summary, and implementation_summary.md, and PR #176 as a source.
entries.reason: PR #176 merged a durable repository convention change: agent-authored prose now explicitly includes commit-message summaries and human-readable workflow metadata fields in the default Chinese language policy. Existing product docs covered the general policy but did not capture those added output categories and examples.

entries.title: Add product change report for 2026-05-26-to-2026-05-27
entries.proposed_patch: No docs/product patch is needed.
entries.reason: PR #177 only adds a generated time-series product change report under docs/updates and updates that report ledger. It does not introduce or change authoritative product behavior, workflow semantics, configuration, permissions, or public contracts; any product details in the report are historical update content rather than long-term product docs.

entries.title: 修复 install.sh 源码树检测
entries.proposed_patch: Updated docs/product/raw/project-installer.md to state that remote execution clones the AICodingFlow source repository only when the script is not already running from a valid AICodingFlow source checkout, and added PR #180 to the source references.
entries.reason: PR #180 changes install.sh source checkout detection to use root AGENTS.md, restoring the intended installer behavior after the agent guidance layout moved. The existing installer doc described remote execution as cloning unconditionally, so it needed a durable clarification for the valid-checkout case.

entries.title: Feat/feature docs 87
entries.proposed_patch: 新增 docs/product/raw/product-docs-sync-workflow.md，记录 product-docs-sync 的触发条件、上下文输入、docs_update 决策合同、写入范围、同步 PR 行为和权威性边界。
entries.reason: PR #179 新增了 merged implementation PR 后自动判断并同步长期产品文档的 workflow、skill 合同、写入边界和同步 PR 行为，属于长期产品工作流变化。现有 docs/product/raw/ 中没有覆盖该产品文档同步流程，因此需要新增权威产品文档。

entries.title: fix(updates): 强化产品变更报告引用校验
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch is needed because the existing authoritative product-change report documentation already reflects the merged behavior.
entries.reason: PR #181 changes the product-change-report workflow's source-reference rules, but the current long-term product docs already cover the merged behavior. docs/product/raw/product-change-reports.md states that generated reports must not contain commit IDs, related issue references must use linked issue GitHub URLs, and PR references are not misclassified when PR and issue numbers match.

entries.title: Add product change report for 2026-05-27
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch needed; the merged PR is a time-series update artifact already covered by existing product change report documentation.
entries.reason: PR #183 only adds a time-series product change report under docs/updates/ and updates that report ledger. Existing product docs already describe product change reports as docs/updates artifacts rather than authoritative long-term product knowledge, so no docs/product update is warranted.

entries.title: Feat/feature docs 87
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the authoritative product docs sync workflow source to document scheduled and manual scan modes, UTC scan windows, unprocessed PR selection, empty-scan stopping behavior, ledger recording, and ledger-only PR creation for not-needed decisions.
entries.reason: PR #184 changed the long-term behavior of the product docs sync workflow from merged-PR event handling to scheduled/manual merged-PR scanning with ledger-based skip and recording semantics. Existing product docs still described the old trigger and not-needed handling, so the workflow documentation needed to be updated.

entries.title: fix(product): 累积处理 product docs sync PR
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the product docs sync workflow documentation to describe skipping self-generated docs sync PRs, the fixed docs/product-docs-sync branch, cumulative open PR behavior, new PR titles and draft handling, expanded ledger fields, and accumulated decision display in the PR body.
entries.reason: PR #187 changes long-term product behavior for the product-docs-sync workflow: generated docs sync PRs now use a fixed cumulative branch, skip self-generated sync PRs during scans, and show accumulated ledger decisions in the PR body. The existing product docs described the older per-source-PR behavior and ledger contents, so the authoritative workflow documentation needed updating.

entries.title: fix(product): 处理 PR 描述中的 referenced issues
entries.proposed_patch: Updated the product docs sync workflow documentation to describe linked issue extraction from closingIssuesReferences plus PR title/body issue-reference keywords, including deduplication order and PR-reference exclusion.
entries.reason: PR #188 changes the product-docs-sync context contract by treating issue references in PR titles and descriptions as linked issues, while preserving GitHub closing reference priority and excluding PR references. Existing product docs described linked issues generically but did not document this source and parsing behavior.

entries.title: fix(create-pr): ignore merged branch prs
entries.proposed_patch: 新增 `docs/product/raw/create-pr-skill.md`，记录 `create-pr` skill 的职责、open PR 复用规则、merged/closed PR 不可复用规则，以及更新既有 open PR 时保留人工内容的要求。
entries.reason: PR #191 改变了 `create-pr` skill 的长期 PR 创建/更新语义：只复用当前分支上的 open PR，merged 或 closed 的同名分支历史 PR 不再阻止新建 PR。现有产品文档没有覆盖 `create-pr` skill 的这一权威行为，因此需要新增 raw 产品文档。

entries.title: feat(product): add product wiki compile workflow
entries.proposed_patch: 新增 docs/product/raw/product-wiki-compile-workflow.md，记录 product wiki 编译 workflow 的触发方式、编译输入输出、写入边界、校验规则和 PR 行为。
entries.reason: PR #193 新增了长期产品能力：定时或手动把 docs/product/raw/ 编译为 docs/product/wiki/ 的 LLM Wiki，并定义输入输出、写入边界、校验规则和固定 PR 行为。现有 raw 产品文档没有覆盖该 workflow，因此需要新增权威产品文档。

entries.title: Compile product wiki
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch is needed; leave `docs/product/` unchanged because the merged PR updated compiled wiki output only.
entries.reason: PR #195 only compiled existing authoritative `docs/product/raw/` content into `docs/product/wiki/` query artifacts. The existing raw product docs already describe the product wiki compile workflow and state that raw docs remain the source of truth, so no long-term authoritative product documentation change is warranted.

entries.title: Compile product wiki
entries.proposed_patch: 不需要修改 `docs/product/`；该变更仅属于已覆盖的 wiki 编译日志更新。
entries.reason: PR #196 只更新了 `docs/product/wiki/log.md` 中一次 product wiki 编译日志的措辞，没有改变长期产品行为、workflow 契约、权限、状态或用户可见规则。现有 `docs/product/raw/product-wiki-compile-workflow.md` 已覆盖 raw 文档是权威来源、wiki 是查询层以及 log 记录编译变更的产品事实。

entries.title: feat: 每小时运行 Product Docs Sync
entries.proposed_patch: Updated docs/product/raw/product-docs-sync-workflow.md to state that scheduled runs trigger every hour at UTC minute 45 and added PR #194 to the source references.
entries.reason: PR #194 changed the Product Docs Sync scheduled cadence from daily to hourly. That is durable workflow behavior already documented in the Product Docs Sync product doc, so the authoritative raw doc needed a small update.

entries.title: Add product change report for 2026-05-28
entries.proposed_patch: No product docs patch is needed; docs/product/ remains unchanged.
entries.reason: PR #197 only adds the dated product change report for 2026-05-28 and updates the product change report ledger under docs/updates/. This is a time-series reporting artifact, not a change to long-term product behavior, workflow contracts, permissions, lifecycle, API semantics, or configuration.
